what: The Hero photo stays in place while only a teardrop-shaped window flies in from off-screen top right (100vw, −100vh) over 2.5s expo.out and settles at (6vw, −8vh) — outside the window the title is ink-dark on the background, inside it the title is white over the photo, so only the spot the window passes turns into photo and white text. At 1.5s the first title line rises from 200% below, tilted 3°, over 1s expo.out and straightens, .4s later the second line follows, at 2.1s the News panel rises from 30% below, and at 2.5s the header row and menu float down from 30% above over 1.2s. On phone the window stretches 2.7x sideways (sx · sy · x options, no look) and covers over 2.5s expo.inOut.

options.from-x · from-y: Position where the window starts, default 100vw · −100vh
options.sx · sy: Horizontal and vertical scale when the window settles, default 1 · 1 — phone original is 2.7 · .9 (x: −65vw)
options.dur · ease: Window length and curve, default 2.5 · 0.19,1,0.22,1 — phone original 0.87,0,0.13,1 (expo.inOut)
options.line-at · line-gap · line-dur: Title line start · gap between lines · duration (seconds), default 1.5 · .4 · 1. Lines with the same data-key go together
options.after-at · after-gap · after-dur: Start of the first follower, delay for the rest, and duration, default 2.1 · .4 · 1.2. Per element data-at (seconds) and data-from (above·fade)
options.with: Selectors (comma-separated) for things outside the part that should rise together — header bar, menu, floating button. Add fx-blob-window-intro-hide to the markup in advance
options.[data-fx-part=window]: Window with a water-drop clip-path — the user supplies the shape
options.[data-fx-part=inside]: Photo and white text group fixed to the screen inside the window
options.[data-fx-part=line]: Rising title lines (text inside an overflow: hidden box)
options.[data-fx-part=after]: Panel (News panel) that rises as the window settles in
options.wait: Wait before starting (seconds), default 0 — the original starts after the first opening curtain lifts, so it is 1 (once curtain, then intro at afterOnce 1s later).
